summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of BHV restaurant showcase website. All core features working correctly including bilingual support, responsive design, navigation, and phone integration.
passed_tests: Hero section displays correctly with restaurant name, slogan, and CTA button
Navigation links work properly with smooth scroll
Language switcher toggles between FR and EN successfully
About section displays restaurant description and image
Menu section shows PDF placeholder correctly
Gallery section displays 6 images in bento grid layout
Contact section shows address, phone, hours, and Google Maps
Mobile responsive design works across different screen sizes
Mobile FAB call button visible and functional with pulse animation
All phone links work correctly (tel: links)
Sticky navigation changes appearance on scroll
